name: bbyte-value-test-94ec1c259b/byte-value-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statement list does not include named worker declarations or worker send statements.

reason: The case requires named workers w1/w2 and byte-valued inter-worker send/receive actions, which are outside the subset positive lists. Consequently the asserted unused-variable diagnostics cannot make the whole case a supported-subset bug.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations (worker w1 / worker w2)
Worker message sends (a -> w2; b -> w1;) and receives (<- w2; <- w1)
test_design_notes: The file asserts unused-variable diagnostics for b and a inside workers; it has no @args, @panic, or @output assertions.
